text:
liam: Deploy finished for release v1.4.2 at 2109876543, canary ramp started to 10% - watching smoke gates now
deploy-bot: post-deploy checks: ALL OK except `synth-embed-eu` failed 3/5 probes in eu-west1, latency increased ~120ms vs baseline, error rate 0.9% -> flagged for attention :rotating_light:
amanda: copying logs, which probe specifically? synthetic embed or kv-prefix?
deploy-bot: probe name `synth-embed-eu`, probe script: `embed-probe --model clinical-embed-v2 --region eu-west1 --count 5`
raj: saw a couple of transient 500s earlier from the proxy but then healed. can we confirm model variant served in eu is v1.4.2 and not an older pinned variant?
jen: I can pull routing table, give me 30s
jen: routing-config shows model: `clinical-embed-v2@v1.4.2` in eu-west1 canary pool (10% traffic). no global pin detected.
liam: ok so canary health check failing in eu only. threshold is 40% passed, we're at 40% (2/5) but errors and latency spike. leaning toward pausing the ramp. thoughts?
amanda: pause ramp, don't rollback yet. let's collect a few more samples (next 5 probes) and check task-level logs for OOMs or kernel Hangs.
raj: agree with pause. if next samples still bad, consider targeted rollback for eu-west1 or pin to previous model variant v1.4.1 for eu region only.
infra-cicd-bot: runbook-snippet: to pause canary: `deploy-bot canary set --release v1.4.2 --region eu-west1 --percent 0`
liam: pausing now. infra-cicd-bot: canary set to 0% for eu-west1 by user liam @2109876558 :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: starting 5 more probes for `synth-embed-eu` now
jen: pulling model server logs from the failed hosts, tail attached:
```
2026-03-20T12:29:10Z model-server[pid=2153] WARN low free GPU memory: 120MB
2026-03-20T12:29:11Z model-server[pid=2153] ERROR inference request failed: cudaLaunchKernel failed: out of memory
2026-03-20T12:29:14Z model-server[pid=2170] INFO kv-cache hit ratio 0.81
```
raj: OOMs on the model-server... that fits latency spikes. do we ship a different config for v1.4.2 (bigger kv-cache or quantization)?
amanda: yes — v1.4.2 enabled a slightly larger prefetched KV cache to optimize tail latency (config change). seems the memory bump pushes some instances over the edge under EU traffic pattern.
liam: given OOM evidence, I propose targeted rollback in eu-west1 to v1.4.1 (previous resource profile). two options: a) pin eu to v1.4.1 immediately, b) redeploy v1.4.2 with reduced cache (hotfix). which is faster?
jen: pin is fastest. infra-cicd-bot: rollback command available: `deploy-bot rollback --region eu-west1 --service clinical-embed-v2 --to v1.4.1 --type model-pin`
liam: execute pin now. infra-cicd-bot: rollback started by liam @2109876592
deploy-bot: model pin in eu-west1 completed -> clinical-embed-v2@v1.4.1 pinned for region eu-west1 :white_check_mark:
amanda: redeploy probe, reporting 5 probes -> all 5 passed, latency back to baseline (~+10ms). great.
liam: thanks. I'll document this in the release notes and mark the change window as partial rollback in eu-west1. we should also create a follow-up to roll forward after we test reduced-KV config in staging.
raj: creating ticket INFRA-1723: "Investigate KV cache mem delta for v1.4.2 and propose safe resource profile" and tagging `p1` for fix plan. link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INFRA-1723
jen: note for release notes: this is a region-scoped pin, global users unaffected. include probe metrics and root cause (OOM due to cache bump).
liam: action items: 1) add a canary-mem-sensitivity check to pre-merge CI for model-server images (jen) 2) run a synthetic load profile matching EU tail shapes in staging (raj) 3) schedule rollback rollback-to-v1.4.2 attempt with config change after INFRA-1723 resolved (liam)
amanda: oncall notified, incident channel created: #inc-21098766 - please add any follow-up comms there.
liam: closing thread here, moving rollout to manual until we have a safe config. :lock:
